title: Buck converter cooling chain
description:
Design the cooling for a synchronous buck converter: Vin = 48 V, Vout = 12 V, Iout = 40 A. Both MOSFETs are identical: Rds(on) = 4.79 mOhm at 25 C with temperature coefficient alpha = 0.0049 per C, i.e. Rds(Tj) = Rds25 * (1 + alpha * (Tj - 25)); switching transition tr + tf = 54 ns; gate charge Qg = 73 nC at Vgs = 10 V. Use this loss model: P_cond = Iout^2 * Rds(Tj) (the two FETs together conduct the full output current), P_sw = 0.5 * Vin * Iout * (tr + tf) * fsw, P_gate = 2 * Qg * Vgs * fsw, P = P_cond + P_sw + P_gate. Efficiency eta = Pout / (Pout + P) with Pout = Vout * Iout.

Both FETs share one heat sink: Tj = Ta + P * (RthJC + RthCS + Rsa), with RthJC = 0.67 C/W, RthCS = 0.45 C/W, Ta = 40 C inside the enclosure. Note Rds depends on Tj, so solve the thermal loop self-consistently. Rsa depends on the air velocity v through the sink; interpolate linearly between the catalog points and clamp outside them. Air velocity v = Q / 3600 / A_duct with A_duct = 0.0045 m2, where Q (m3/h) is the fan operating point: the flow at which the fan's static pressure (interpolate linearly between its curve points) equals the enclosure system curve dP = k * Q^2 with k = 0.0136 Pa/(m3/h)^2. With no fan, v = 0.

Ripple: inductor L = 11.8 uH, output capacitor C = 307 uF, D = Vout / Vin. dI = Vout * (1 - D) / (L * fsw) must not exceed 12.0 A and dV = dI / (8 * C * fsw) must not exceed 50 mV.

Constraints: fsw between 50 and 500 kHz; Tj <= 120 C; eta >= 97.0%; fan noise <= 35 dBA (no fan = 0 dBA); heat sink height <= 35 mm; heat sink price + fan price <= 35.

Heat sink catalog:
  HS-1: Rsa = 11.32 / 5.66 / 3.96 / 2.83 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 15 mm, price 1.86
  HS-2: Rsa = 7.54 / 3.77 / 2.64 / 1.89 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 25 mm, price 4.48
  HS-3: Rsa = 5.19 / 2.45 / 1.7 / 1.23 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 35 mm, price 7.56
  HS-4: Rsa = 3.58 / 1.7 / 1.18 / 0.85 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 45 mm, price 9.90
  HS-5: Rsa = 2.45 / 1.13 / 0.8 / 0.57 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 60 mm, price 19.62
  HS-6: Rsa = 1.7 / 0.8 / 0.57 / 0.42 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 80 mm, price 25.81

Fan catalog (or use no fan):
  FAN-A (40x40x10 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 28.3], [7.1, 17.0], [11.3, 8.5], [14.1, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 28 dBA, price 3.12
  FAN-B (60x60x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 42.4], [18.9, 25.5], [30.2, 12.7], [37.7, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 32 dBA, price 5.34
  FAN-C (80x80x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 37.7], [33.0, 22.6], [52.8, 11.3], [66.0, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 30 dBA, price 6.80
  FAN-D (80x80x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 84.9], [51.9, 50.9], [83.0, 25.5], [103.7, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 42 dBA, price 15.54
  FAN-E (92x92x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 103.7], [75.4, 62.2], [120.7, 31.1], [150.9, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 46 dBA, price 17.29

Any design satisfying every constraint passes. Return {"fsw_hz": <number>, "heatsink": "<id>", "fan": "<id>" or null}.
